comment: Single source of truth for Loki setup requirements per execution path. Read by loki-ts/src/commands/doctor.ts (doctor, runtime errors), autonomy/provider-offer.sh (bash fallback), autonomy/setup-wizard.sh (loki setup) and tests (the generated block in docs/alternative-installations.md is asserted against it). Edit here, then run UPDATE_CONTRACT=1 bun test tests/commands/doctor.test.ts from loki-ts.

paths.title: Claude Code CLI path (default, loki start)
paths.summary: Loki drives the claude binary you installed and logged in

paths.title: Anthropic API-key path (Agent SDK, no claude CLI)
paths.summary: Opt-in with LOKI_SDK_MODE=full; the bundled Agent SDK runs the loop over HTTPS

paths.title: Other provider CLIs
paths.summary: codex (degraded), cline, aider, opencode: any one replaces the claude CLI

requirements.label: Python 3.8 or newer
requirements.fix: install python3 with your package manager (brew install python3)

requirements.label: jq
requirements.fix: install jq with your package manager (brew install jq)

requirements.label: git
requirements.fix: install git with your package manager (brew install git)

requirements.label: curl
requirements.fix: install curl with your package manager (brew install curl)

requirements.label: bash 4.0 or newer
requirements.fix: install a newer bash (brew install bash); macOS ships 3.2

requirements.label: Bun 1.3 or newer (bundled by npm install)
requirements.fix: reinstall without --no-optional (npm bundles @oven/bun-*) or install from https://bun.sh; without it loki falls back to the slower bash CLI

requirements.label: claude CLI on PATH (then log in: claude auth login)
Anthropic credentials (API key, auth token or gateway URL)
Claude Agent SDK platform binary (optional npm dependency)
requirements.fix: reinstall without --no-optional: npm install -g loki-mode (the SDK is an optionalDependency)

requirements.label: Bun runtime (the SDK loop runs only on the Bun route)
requirements.fix: reinstall without --no-optional (npm bundles @oven/bun-*) or install from https://bun.sh

missing_optional.effect: The api-key-sdk path is unavailable and doctor reports it not ready. The claude-cli path and all other providers are unaffected.
bin/loki falls back to the bash CLI (slower). The api-key-sdk path is unavailable because the SDK loop runs only on Bun.
